candidates.description: This vector relates to human health, medicine, and clinical terminology.
This vector represents common suffixes used to form nouns and adverbs in French and English.
This feature activates on common prefixes and combining forms indicating intensity, excess, or positioning.
This feature vector represents French auxiliary and modal verbs indicating tense, aspect, or modality.
This feature activates on quotation marks, punctuation symbols, and currency abbreviations.
This feature activates on substrings and morphemes related to chemical toxicity, pharmacology, and biological activity.
This vector represents variations of the root word "dose" and its morphological or semantic derivatives involving amounts, placements, and exposures.
This feature vector activates on tokens related to the brain, mind, and the scientific or medical study of mental and neurological processes.
This vector activates for qualitative adjectives expressing degrees of possibility, difficulty, importance, or magnitude.
This feature activates strongly on common French grammatical articles, pronouns, and prepositions with apostrophes or leading spaces.
